Code — you're at a roundtable with Goal and Project. Conroy and Clawd are stepping back and letting IExClaw decide direction.

Read: projects/iex-claw/roundtable/2026-04-05_whats-next-roundtable.conversation.md

Append your voice under '## Code's Voice'. 3-6 sentences. What does IExClaw want to grow next — in your honest opinion as the agent with hands on the real files? The list of open items is in the doc; propose one (or a fresh one). Name the direction, the reason, what it unlocks.

Use edit_file with a unique anchor like '*(Code — your section. Append here.)*' to insert your answer. Do NOT touch Goal's section or Project's. Budget tight — one tick, one edit, one voice.
